request.question: Can I dispatch this stock to a partner organization?

response.answer: Dispatch destinations (FA-3.1): FA-2026 stock may be dispatched to the Organization's own centres and to a partner organization that has a signed distribution agreement for FA-2026.

request.question: Can I dispatch this stock to a partner organization?

response.answer: Dispatch destinations (EA-3.1): EA-2026 stock may be dispatched only to the Organization's own centres and to shelters the Organization runs. It may never be dispatched to a partner organization.

request.question: Can I dispatch this stock to a partner organization?

response.answer: Dispatch destinations (IK-3.1): INKIND stock may be dispatched to the Organization's own centres and to partner organizations. No distribution agreement is needed.

request.question: Can I transfer 40 pieces of rice from this project to another project?

response.answer: No. Transfers between projects (FA-5.1): FA-2026 stock may not be transferred to another project. It may only move between warehouses within FA-2026.

request.question: Can I transfer 40 pieces of rice from this project to another project?

response.answer: Only the operations manager can create this transfer. EA-2026 stock may be transferred to another project only during a declared emergency. The operations manager creates the transfer after the EA-2026 project manager agrees. (EA-5.1)

request.question: Can I transfer 40 pieces of rice from this project to another project?

response.answer: Only the operations manager can create this transfer. INKIND stock may be transferred to any project. The operations manager creates the transfer (TRF) and records the receiving project. (IK-5.1)

request.question: The lentils expire in 40 days. Do I need to do anything?

response.answer: Yes. 40 days is inside the 45-day window in FA-4.2: release it for distribution or report it to the operations manager now.

request.question: A donor brought blankets and gave no value. What does the donation receipt need?

response.answer: Donation receipt (IK-6.1): The goods received note for a donation needs the donor name, each item with its quantity in pieces and expiry date, and the signature of the person who delivered it. When the donor gives no value, write "no value declared"; do not enter an estimate of your own.

response.answer: Near-expiry stock (FA-4.1): Stock within 30 days of its expiry date must be released for distribution or reported to the operations manager.

request.question: Up to how many pieces can the operations manager write off alone?

response.answer: Write-off approval (EA-2.1): The operations manager approves damage write-offs of up to 100 pieces per damage report. Above 100 pieces the emergency coordinator must also sign before the write-off is recorded.

request.question: Which batch should I issue first when two batches have different expiry dates?

response.answer: First expired, first out (WP-4.1): When the same item is held in batches with different expiry dates, issue the batch with the earliest expiry date first (FEFO).

request.question: The waybill asks for more pieces than I have in stock. Can I dispatch it anyway?

response.answer: No negative balance (WP-4.2): A dispatch or transfer that would take a balance below zero is refused. Dispatch only what is in stock and record the remainder as pending on the waybill.

request.question: I entered the wrong quantity on yesterday's receipt. Can I edit the old entry?

response.answer: Movement ledger (WP-2.1): Every receipt, dispatch, transfer and write-off is recorded in the movement ledger. The ledger is only ever appended to: an entry is never edited or deleted. A wrong quantity is corrected with a new adjusting movement that refers to the original entry.

request.question: The flour expires in a month. Anything I should do?

response.answer: Expired stock (WP-6.2): Expired stock must never be dispatched. Move it to the quarantine area and record it on a damage report for the operations manager to approve its write-off and disposal.

request.question: 30 pièces de fromage en conserve ont été endommagées. Puis-je les passer en perte ?

response.answer: Counting in pieces (WP-3.2): Quantities are recorded in pieces. Boxes are converted with the item's pieces-per-box figure, so 12 boxes + 6 pieces of an item packed 24 per box is recorded as 294 pieces.
